text:
liz (marketing): Heads-up: planning to ship SparkPad mini-refapp (OSS) + 20m hands-on tutorial. Channels: blog post, gated webinar, short demo clip, and repeatable benchmark report. Target date: two weeks out. Need quick takes on benchmark framing, webinar hook, and inbound routing.

kevin (devrel): Nice. For the benchmark narrative, keep it story-driven: pick one realistic app (search assist), show two scenarios (cold cache vs warmed KV cache), surface p50/p95 and cost-per-1k-tokens. One clear takeaway per chart.

mari (growth): RSVP gating: single-select question "Your role" -> (engineering, product, platform). Route to three nurture tracks. Use utm_medium and utm_campaign per channel.

hugo (engineer): Repo is public: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sparkpad. Bench script: `bench/run_bench.py --concurrency 12 --seq 192 --save report.json`. It emits JSON + CSV.

courtney (events): Webinar format: 30m total: 12m demo, 8m benchmark walkthrough, 10m Q&A. Proposed: Tue 11am PT to hit EU afternoon. Speakers: liz + kevin demo, hugo infra. We'll create a 90s teaser clip for social.

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://sparkpad-preview.redwood.ai 680 4c4 build #303 OK.

kevin (devrel): Draft copy options:
Blog blurb: "SparkPad mini-refapp: a quick OSS example that gets you from repo to running refapp with a reproducible benchmark and notes for production tuning."
Social: "New: SparkPad mini-refapp  a 20m tutorial + reproducible benchmark for LLM features. Live demo Tue 11am PT. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/sparkpad (utm=tw)"

liz (marketing): Swap in "benchmark reproducibility" phrase and list "includes Docker + k8s manifest" on the blog blurb. Keep social short.

mari (growth): Routing: send RSVPs to /workflows/sparkpad-webinar. Tag leads `sparkpad_webinar_rsvp`. Post-webinar: immediate email with repo + report link, then segmented follow-up per role. We'll set up a 50/50 A/B for the post-webinar subject lines.

hugo (engineer): During the demo we'll run `bench/run_bench.py --save report.json` and upload with `aws s3 cp report.json s3://redwood-sparkpad/reports/`. Sample report: {"p50_ms": 36, "p95_ms": 92, "cost_per_1k": "$0.11"}. We'll annotate which instance type was used.

courtney (events): Ops checklist: 1) landing page & RSVP form 2) rehearsal + record teaser 3) slides & demo script 4) tracking UTMs 5) infra on-call. Who's owning the teaser?

liz (marketing): I'll do slides + blog. kevin you own demo script + social snippets. mari you own registration funnel + tags. hugo infra/on-call + report structure. courtney events ops & rehearsal.

kevin (devrel): I'll add three prompts to the tutorial to highlight batching and cache wins. Will prepare a 2-min highlight clip in rehearsal.

mari (growth): A/B subject lines for post-webinar: A) "Your SparkPad benchmark + quickstart" B) "How we hit 36ms p50   SparkPad results". I'll split 50/50 and measure opens.

hugo (engineer): Small caveat: bench numbers vary by instance; will include a table of dev (g5) vs prod (a100) typical ranges. Also will normalize cost numbers to $/1k tokens.

ci-bot: Calendar event created: 2026-06-SPARK-01. Reminder scheduled for speakers.

courtney (events): Rehearsal scheduled one day before, 30m. Please confirm speaker availability.

liz (marketing): Confirmed. Quick ask on messaging iteration: let's A/B the webhook CTA wording on the landing page: "Get the repo + benchmark" vs "Get the quickstart & results". Which is crisper?

mari (growth): I'll test both on the landing page with a small 50/50 split. My gut says "Get the quickstart & results" for conversions.

kevin (devrel): Final: can we produce a 60s cut of the demo for LinkedIn & Twitter? I'll record during rehearsal and handover to marketing for captions.

liz (marketing): Thanks all. Next check-in Friday 10am PT to finalize assets. I'll post PR links and the landing page draft here when ready. :thumbsup:
